description: 阅读理解：基于课文的选择题，检验理解程度

questions.question: What should we do to the Earth?
questions.questionCn: 我们应该对地球做什么？
questions.explanation: 课文说：Earth is our home. We should protect the Earth. 地球是我们的家园，我们应该保护地球。

questions.question: What is the main question in the class discussion?
questions.questionCn: 班级讨论的主要问题是什么？

options.label: A
options.textCn: 你最喜欢的颜色是什么？

options.label: B
options.text: What can we do to go green?
options.textCn: 我们能做些什么来践行绿色生活？

questions.explanation: 老师问：What can we do to go green? 我们能做些什么来践行绿色生活？这是课堂讨论的核心问题。

questions.question: What should we do to save water?
questions.questionCn: 我们应该怎样节约用水？

options.label: A
options.text: Leave the tap running when brushing teeth.
options.textCn: 刷牙时让水龙头一直开着。

options.label: B
options.text: Turn off the tap when brushing teeth.

questions.explanation: 课文说：Turn off the tap when you brush your teeth. Don't waste water. 刷牙时关掉水龙头，不要浪费水。

questions.question: What should we do to save electricity?
questions.questionCn: 我们应该怎样节约用电？

options.label: A
options.text: Leave lights on when we leave.

options.label: B
options.text: Turn off lights when we leave the room.

questions.explanation: 课文说：Turn off lights when you leave the room. Don't waste electricity. 离开房间时关灯，不要浪费电。

questions.question: How can we save paper?
questions.questionCn: 我们怎样才能节约用纸？

options.label: A
options.text: Use only one side of the paper.

options.label: B
options.text: Use both sides of the paper.

options.label: C
options.text: Throw paper away after one use.

questions.explanation: 课文说：Use both sides of the paper. Don't waste paper. 使用纸的两面，不要浪费纸。

questions.question: What kind of bags should we use?
questions.questionCn: 我们应该使用什么样的袋子？
questions.explanation: 课文说：Use cloth bags! Don't use too many plastic bags. 使用布袋！不要用太多塑料袋。

questions.question: What should we do about food?
questions.questionCn: 关于食物我们应该怎么做？

options.label: A
options.text: Eat up our food. Don't waste food.
options.textCn: 把食物吃光，不要浪费食物。

options.label: C
options.text: Order more than we can eat.

questions.explanation: 课文说：Eat up your food. Don't waste food. 把你的食物吃光，不要浪费食物。

questions.question: What are Bobby and his friends doing?
questions.questionCn: Bobby和他的朋友们在做什么？

options.label: B
options.text: They are doing a project for Earth Day.
options.textCn: 他们在做一个地球日的项目。

options.label: C
options.text: They are having a birthday party.

questions.explanation: 课文说：Bobby, Sam and their friends are doing a project for Earth Day. Bobby、Sam和他们的朋友们正在做一个地球日的项目。

questions.question: What will Sam do on the poster?

options.label: B
options.text: He will draw the Earth and colour it green and blue.
options.textCn: 他要画地球，把它涂成绿色和蓝色。

options.label: C
options.text: He will draw a rubbish bin.

questions.explanation: Sam说：I'll draw the Earth and colour it green and blue. 我要画地球，把它涂成绿色和蓝色。

questions.question: What will Billy draw?
questions.explanation: Billy说：I'll draw a rubbish bin. 我要画一个垃圾桶。

questions.question: What will Willy write on the poster?
questions.explanation: Willy说：I'll write "Reduce, reuse and recycle!" 我要写「减少、再利用、回收利用！」

questions.question: What did Bobby want to draw at first?
questions.explanation: Bobby说：I'll draw some banana trees. I like bananas. 我要画一些香蕉树，我喜欢香蕉。

questions.question: Why is the rubbish bin for Bobby?
questions.questionCn: 为什么说垃圾桶是给Bobby的？

options.label: B
options.text: Because Bobby always throws banana skins everywhere.
options.textCn: 因为Bobby总是到处扔香蕉皮。

options.label: D
options.text: Because Bobby is a rubbish bin.

questions.explanation: Billy说：It's for your banana skins! 这是给你扔香蕉皮用的！因为Bobby之前乱扔香蕉皮的坏习惯。

questions.question: What did Bobby learn?

options.label: A
options.text: He should throw more banana skins.

options.label: B
options.text: He should help protect the Earth and not throw rubbish on the ground.
options.textCn: 他应该帮助保护地球，不把垃圾扔在地上。

questions.explanation: Bobby说：I'll help protect the Earth. I won't throw banana skins on the ground any more. 我会帮助保护地球，我再也不会把香蕉皮扔在地上了。

questions.question: What is the main idea of this unit?
questions.questionCn: 这个单元的主旨是什么？

options.label: B
options.text: We should go green and protect the Earth in our daily life.
options.textCn: 我们应该在日常生活中践行绿色生活，保护地球。

options.label: C
options.text: We should make posters every day.

options.label: D
options.textCn: 我们应该浪费更多资源。

questions.explanation: 整个单元都在告诉我们：绿色生活要从身边小事做起——节约用水、节约用电、节约用纸、不浪费食物、使用布袋、参加环保活动，共同保护我们的地球家园。
